author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
**EveDash** — Web Dashboard for Red-DiscordBot

Run `[p]evedash setup` to configure your dashboard.
See the README for full documentation.
name: EveDash
short: A modern, self-contained web dashboard for Red-DiscordBot.
description: EveDash is a sleek, Discord-inspired web dashboard that lets you manage your Red bot from a browser. Features Discord OAuth2 login, guild management, cog control, command toggles, real-time WebSocket updates, and a powerful SDK that lets any cog register its own settings pages with just a few lines of code.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs for authentication sessions and blacklist management. No message content is stored.
